history.sql:
SELECT T1.account_id, T1.date, T3.amount FROM account AS T1 
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T1.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31' AND T3.duration > 12 
ORDER BY T3.amount DESC LIMIT 1
